claims.evidence: Photo shows the iron resting but does not show steam vents, water reservoir, or any steam being produced; 'industrial strength' is not a visible attribute.
No video or clip showing the iron powered on, heating, or producing steam; a static photo cannot confirm function.
A guarantee is a seller promise, not something a photo can show; no document or receipt visible.

claims.claim: Brand is Morphy Richards (implied by labeling)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows partially visible logo text reading 'Morphy Richards' and 'SPEED' on the body.

risks.risk: Iron may not power on or heat properly
risks.proof: Short video clip of the iron plugged in, powering on, and reaching heat (steam or water droplet test).
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: Soleplate may be scratched, stained, or have residue affecting fabric contact
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the soleplate from underneath in good light.

risks.risk: Steam function or water reservoir may be faulty, cracked, or missing parts
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the water fill opening, reservoir interior, and steam output when powered.

risks.risk: Power cord or plug may be damaged or frayed, posing safety risk
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full cord length and plug pins/prongs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cord/plug condition unknown, safety risk discount applied

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history, affecting remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Photo of any date code, serial number, or original purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, unknown age

risks.risk: Guarantee claim cannot be substantiated remotely
risks.proof: Photo of a written/signed guarantee note or seller's shop details enabling after-sale contact.
risks.if_unproven: priced as no guarantee, buyer-assumes-risk basis

proof_requests: Video of the iron plugged in and heating up, ideally with steam/water test
Photo of the full power cord and plug
Photo of the water reservoir/fill opening
Any photo of a model number, serial number, or date code
Photo of a written guarantee note or seller contact details
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a Morphy Richards electric iron, so it can be priced, but functional claims like 'strong industrial steaming' and 'tested ok' are unverifiable from a single static photo and must be priced at worst case until proof is provided.
